notes.title: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
notes.notes:
The motorcycle buying and selling game Motorcycle For Sale Simulator will be released very soon.

Buy, fix, customize, and sell motorcycles. Start with old bikes, restore every part, test ride, and grow your own dealership. Take risks, make smart deals, and become the best in town

Please add it to your wishlist.

notes.title: HotFix v0.0.6 # Update Notes 16.06.2025
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/JZ8HqFfXVs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614396/1e9e2ba3c99ac83fbebb634c1bc7112eaecaca67.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]

We recently released a hotfix, and now we’re back with another one to keep improving your Gun Shop Manager experience!

Thanks so much for all the feedback you've shared with us during Steam Next Fest. Your support keeps us going, and we’re committed to making the game even better with each update.

Here’s what’s been fixed in this update:

[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed the "Load" button being stuck in the main menu.
[*] Fixed issue where money could be given without a customer present.
[*] Fixed interaction errors with the weapon paint table.
[*] Fixed tablet screen remaining open when starting a new game.
[*] Fixed issue where the weapon configuration desk tutorial would not close.
[/list]

This is just the beginning we’re committed to making Gun Shop Manager the best it can be, and your feedback plays a crucial role in that journey. Keep it coming!

[h1][b]Add to Wishlist Now![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656640/Gun_Shop_Manager/

[h1][b]Play Now![/b][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3679990/Gun_Shop_Manager_Demo/

Thank you again,

[b]Gun Shop Manager Team[/b]

notes.title: HotFix v0.0.6 # Update Notes 12.06.2025
notes.notes:
[url=https://discord.gg/JZ8HqFfXVs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614396/1e9e2ba3c99ac83fbebb634c1bc7112eaecaca67.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h1]

Thank you so much for playing the Gun Shop Manager demo on Steam Next Fest! Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm mean the world to us.

We’re aware of the issues some of you encountered, and our team has been working around the clock to improve the experience. Here's what we've tackled so far:

[h1][b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*] Resolved various issues affecting gameplay flow and overall feel.
[*] Fixed AI behavior inconsistencies and rebalanced core systems.
[*] Addressed problems with input devices and improved UI responsiveness.
[*] Fixed several major bugs that significantly impacted gameplay.
[*] Corrected localization issues and added support for 12 languages.
[*] Fixed issues with the weapon configuration system and improved its functionality.
[*] Resolved bugs related to the day loop and enhanced its performance.
[/list]

This is just the beginning we’re committed to making Gun Shop Manager the best it can be, and your feedback plays a crucial role in that journey. Keep it coming!
